title: Olomòc — faction reference
description: Faction memberships (faction reference, rulebook p.32), language-neutral: the names of the factions are in the language packs. The faction declares its members, so a cog can belong to several factions without redundancy.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for autocompletion in the editor.

version.description: Version of the faction reference. Evolves independently of the card catalog.

source.description: Source of the Occicat document transcribed here (URL, edition date).

factionCode.description: Faction code: internal identifier in English (the displayed name is in name). No code is printed on the cards.

cardId.description: Identifier of a cog of the card catalog (code printed on the back of the card).
cardId.$comment: Must stay aligned with $defs/id of olomoc.schema.json.

alignment.description: Alignment of the faction: Light (LIGHT) or Darkness (DARK). Used by tournament pairings that avoid matches of the same alignment.

cogIds.description: Cogs recruitable in this faction. A cabal is composed entirely within a single faction.
